Repair Cafe

Thursday 24 September 2026, 10:00am

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

Bring a broken thing — a lamp, a jumper, a bike, a toaster — and sit with a volunteer who helps you fix it. Tools and common spare parts on the bench; sewing machines at the back. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm.

Free. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
